popup.title: Golf in the Austin Region
popup.subtitle: A Product Intelligence Report
popup.body: 20 golf facilities are profiled in this report. Types covered include 8 municipal GolfATX courses, 9 public and daily-fee layouts, and 3 resort destinations. Hancock Golf Course — the oldest continuously operated course in Texas — and Lions Municipal Golf Course are two highlighted locations from the report.

popup.title: Hancock Golf Course
popup.subtitle: Oldest continuously operated course in Texas — est. 1899
popup.body: Golf has been played at this central Austin site since 1899, when it was the original Austin Country Club founded by former mayor Lewis Hancock. The nine-hole par-35 layout with its pronounced hills over Waller Creek remains one of the most walkable and historic rounds in Texas. Green fees start around $20.

popup.title: Lions Municipal Golf Course
popup.subtitle: One of the first desegregated public courses in the South
popup.body: Opened in 1924 on land leased from UT, Lions Municipal became historically significant as one of the first de facto desegregated public courses in the South — predating Brown v. Board of Education. Still hosts the Firecracker Open, Texas's oldest amateur tournament. Harvey Penick mentored players here for decades.
